sourceChecks.message: Add `--page: #f8fafc;` to the intended `:root` rule for this step.
Add `background: var(--page);` to the intended `body` rule for this step.

Add `width: min(70rem, calc(100% - 2rem));` to the intended `main,
.site-header,
footer` rule for this step.

Add `color: var(--accent-strong);` to the intended `.eyebrow,
.speaker-role` rule for this step.

.page-heading p,

.schedule-grid,

Add `color: #ffffff;` to the intended `nav a:hover,
.button-link:hover,
